Import required library
```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)
```


```{r}
data <- read.table("/Users/sorenbasnet/Documents/Github/STAT_443_FINAL_PROJECT/data/data_patient_file_cna_rai_mutation/patient_cna_rai_mutation.txt", header=TRUE, sep=" ")
```


```{r}
# Get names of all columns from SAMD11 to the end
gene_names <- colnames(data)[58:ncol(data)]

# Create the formula string: "death_5yr ~ SAMD11 + NOC2L + ..."
gene_formula <- as.formula(paste("death_5yr ~", paste(gene_names, collapse = " + ")))

# Run the model
m1 <- glm(gene_formula, data = data, family = 'binomial')
summary(m1)
```
